svg.title: Resonances of a tube closed at one end
svg.desc: Four tubes of length L closed at the left end, each with no air displacement at the closed end and the most at the open end. Fundamental: a quarter wavelength fits, λ1 = 4L, f1 = v/4L. First overtone: three quarters of a wavelength, λ2 = 4L/3, f2 = 3v/4L. Second overtone: λ3 = 4L/5, f3 = 5v/4L. Third overtone: λ4 = 4L/7, f4 = 7v/4L.
